keyPoints.en: Perlis, Kedah, Kelantan and Terengganu were under Siamese influence (bunga emas). Johor was independent and modern.
keyPoints.bm: Perlis, Kedah, Kelantan dan Terengganu di bawah pengaruh Siam (bunga emas). Johor bebas dan moden.

keyPoints.en: Written constitutions: Johor 1895 (Sultan Abu Bakar), Terengganu 1911 (Sultan Zainal Abidin III).
keyPoints.bm: Perlembagaan bertulis: Johor 1895 (Sultan Abu Bakar), Terengganu 1911 (Sultan Zainal Abidin III).

keyPoints.en: Bangkok Treaty 1909: Siam transferred its claims over Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan and Terengganu to Britain.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian Bangkok 1909: Siam memindahkan tuntutan ke atas Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan dan Terengganu kepada British.

keyPoints.en: Kelantan Adviser 1910; Terengganu Agent 1910, Adviser 1919; formal treaties Kedah 1923, Perlis 1930.
keyPoints.bm: Penasihat Kelantan 1910; Ejen Terengganu 1910, Penasihat 1919; perjanjian rasmi Kedah 1923, Perlis 1930.

keyPoints.en: 1885 treaty recognised Sultan Abu Bakar; Britain handled foreign affairs. Johor accepted a General Adviser in 1914.
keyPoints.bm: Perjanjian 1885 mengiktiraf Sultan Abu Bakar; British mengendalikan hal ehwal luar. Johor menerima Penasihat Am pada 1914.

keyPoints.en: UMS: each state separate with a British Adviser; rulers kept more power; local officials and State Councils remained important.
keyPoints.bm: NNMTB: setiap negeri berasingan dengan Penasihat British; raja mengekalkan lebih banyak kuasa; pegawai tempatan dan Majlis Mesyuarat Negeri kekal penting.

tip.bm: NNMB = Residen + Residen Jeneral; NNMTB = Penasihat.
